description: Searches Trello members by name, username, or email, optionally scoped to a board or organization.

idBoard.description: Optional board ID to scope the search to members relevant to that board.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idOrganization.description: Optional organization/workspace ID to scope the search to that organization.
idOrganization.title: Id Organization

limit.description: Maximum number of member records to return (string '1'-'20'). Default is 8.
limit.title: Limit

onlyOrgMembers.description: When 'true' and idOrganization is provided, only return members of that organization. Values: 'true' or 'false'.
onlyOrgMembers.title: Only Org Members

query.description: Search query for Trello members by name, username, or email (1-16384 characters).
query.title: Query

name: get_search_members

data.description: Response data containing the list of found Trello members.
data.title: Data

GetSearchMembersResponseData.description: Response data containing the list of found members.

details.description: List of Trello member objects matching the search query.
details.title: Details

GetSearchMembersResponseData.title: GetSearchMembersResponseData

TrelloMember.description: Schema for a Trello member object returned by search.

active.description: Whether the member is currently active.
active.title: Active

avatarUrl.description: URL to the member's avatar image.
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

confirmed.description: Whether the member's email is confirmed.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

dateLastActive.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the member's last activity.
dateLastActive.title: Date Last Active

fullName.description: Full display name of the member.
fullName.title: Full Name

id.description: Unique identifier for the Trello member.
id.title: Id

idBoards.description: List of board IDs the member belongs to.
idBoards.title: Id Boards

idOrganizations.description: List of organization IDs the member belongs to.
idOrganizations.title: Id Organizations

TrelloMember.title: TrelloMember
